Name: FS - SH's Gloves and Sleeves Pack
Author: Plurffle
TagLine: Adds several recolorable gloves and sleeves to your game via Fashion Sense framework
Description:
Just like my Cottagecore Set, this has been sitting untouched in my laptop since November 2022. It was almost done by then even, I just decided to take a break __again__.  There isn't much in this pack as of now, but if I'll add more if I get more ideas. There are currently only 15 pieces for you to choose from (see images to know what are included in this FS pack), all recolorable.

**The sleeves and gloves work for both female and male farmer sprites (each accessory/sleeves have two versions each).**

![](https://imgur.com/OrH6e66.png)
As of version 1.1, there are _9 in the Sleeves category_ and __6 in the Accessories category__.

![](https://imgur.com/bBYKTj4.png)
[Link to frequently asked questions and known issues section](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/2050)

![](https://imgur.com/lT7uwQV.png)
Mods used in the preview pictures:

*   [Fashion Sense](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969) example pack

I just created a Ko-fi! If you like my works, then feel free to [buy me a coffee](https://ko-fi.com/smolhooman_plurffle) ~! I'll greatly appreciate the support! <3 However, my mods will always stay free for the public!
